camel_example: aliyun oceanbasepro BatchKillSessionList --region cn-hangzhou --TenantId t4louaeei0000 --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --SessionList '342,354,343'
description_en: You can call this operation to close sessions between the ApsaraDB for OceanBase and the application in batches. Please note that this operation is executed asynchronously. After calling this operation, you need to verify it by calling DescribeSessionList
description_zh: 该接口用于批量关闭 OceanBase 云服务和业务之间的会话信息。该接口为异步执行，需要用户通过 DescribeSessionList 验证会话是否关闭成功
